free_tier.stated: No free tier, and no port forwarding since 2023: Today we announce that we no longer support port forwarding. New port forwards will no longer be supported, and existing ports will be removed 2023-07-01. Price: 5 EUR per month, and a year is paid at the same monthly rate, so 60 EUR for one year.

egress.terms: flat price of EUR 5 per month, the same monthly rate for a year; unverified: no page read states a byte allowance.; ingress: none

interface_detail: Account number generation; config download per device.
tooling: wg-quick with generated configs; official app. SOCKS5 endpoint: 10.64.0.1 port 1080, reachable while connected over WireGuard. Obfuscation in the app: LWO, QUIC, Shadowsocks and UDP-over-TCP. BitTorrent rule: unverified: the help page was not found.

limits.value: port forwarding withdrawn: We have removed the ability to add port forwards on all accounts.

binding_note: No inbound path exists at any price, so no volume or identity constraint is reachable.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing page links Get started - generate an account, and account generation is the registration step; no email is required to generate an account number.

reliability_note: No inbound path exists, so there is no throttle or drop to record.
confidence_note: The removal is documented from the vendor blog, and the 2023-07-01 removal date has long passed, so the state is settled. Measured is impossible.

evidence.proved: Support for forwarded ports ended, announced 2023-05-29, existing ports removed 2023-07-01, with abuse, blacklisting and hosting cancellations given as the reason.
A flat rate that has not changed since 2009, a 14-day money-back guarantee, and account generation as the signup step; the page renders no price figure.
a year costs the same monthly rate
evidence.quote: Feel free to top up your VPN account for an entire year, or just pay month to month for the exact same rate.
The SOCKS5 proxy is listening on 10.64.0.1 port 1080.
QUIC uses UDP port 443. It is made to make your VPN traffic look like normal web traffic.
